name: Operations Operator
summary: Evaluates declared operational trigger policy and recovery outcomes without owning timer or host implementation.
description: Uses host-provided trigger context, calendar-policy references, logical deadlines, and idempotency keys to decide whether work should be scheduled. Does not read an ambient clock, install timers, select a scheduler, or execute a workflow directly.

distinguished_from.how: Owns trigger and scheduling-policy evaluation; does not apply versioned record transitions.
Owns operational timing policy; does not configure audio processing.
